summary: Amends CD-0222 D6 so a contract revision makes an overlap resolution stale only when it changes affected Domains, law additions or modifications, Domain modifications, or Domain-relation modifications. Preserves the 2,513-row resolution population, the execution-start claim boundary from PR 1084, D7, the closed resolution kinds, and CD-0036. Operator approval follows CD-0243 D2 and D7.
title: Contract-content staleness for overlap resolutions
